snippet.title: Seasons Turning | Mid-Dev Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the first trailer for Seasons Turning, which is a solo dev game about halfway through what's expected to be a 4 year development cycle. It introduces zelda-esk world exploration, puzzle mechanics, and environmental immersion with the cozy farming sim genre.

You can wishlist it on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3105040/Seasons_Turning/

I submitted to the Godot 2025 Showreel this week and much of the work needed for it is also work needed for a trailer so I put this guy together for the steam page, and couldn't resist adding it here too, though it contains some small spoilers for my next two progress videos.  It's not super orthodox in its formatting (I know it's terrible to start slow) but it felt right.

This video's music is Mandolin by Liborio Conti
